page.p.026: Football Career Sim is a mobile football (soccer) career simulation by YT Lab. A seventeen-year-old from the academy fights for a place off the bench, moves clubs, earns a national team call-up and decides when to retire. Growth Cards picked every two seasons change that path, and retired players become the squad of your club in the Weekly League.
page.p.027: Reroll each card once. Its rarity stays the same.
page.p.028: These are the app’s actual cards and calculations: the moment a 27-year-old star Striker draws the rarest round, Legend. Rerolls and the next draws use the app’s own card pools and odds, and every demo round starts with the same player.
page.p.029: Free to download, with in-app purchases. Available on iPhone and iPad with iOS 15 or later, and Android 7.0 or later.
page.p.030: Your stats grow automatically as you play. Growth Cards add a choice on top. At the start and every two seasons after that, choose one of three cards of the same rarity, each from a different family. Higher rarities have stronger effects, and your first pick is guaranteed to be Epic.
page.p.031: Your stats rise as soon as you pick. Focus Pays Off gives a core stat +6 and its ceiling +3. Fill the Gaps adds 4 each to your lowest core and support stats.
page.p.032: Every stat has a hidden ceiling where automatic growth stops. A Little Potential, Open Potential and Potential Breakthrough push that ceiling higher. Cards can raise it to 95.
page.p.033: Goal Hunter gives Finishing +1 for every 5 goals. Star of the Match adds +2 to a stat for every 2 MOM awards. Ready to Rise gives a core stat +8 after 30 appearances. You have to earn it.
page.p.034: Explosive Sprint trades Aerial −3 for Pace +8. Devilish Talent gives a core ceiling +12 and stat +10, at the cost of a support stat −3. Every gain has a price.
page.p.035: Second Prime halves aging for three seasons and extends your career by 2 years. Last Flame adds +6 to three core stats, but you retire at the end of that season.
page.p.036: Don’t like a card? Reroll it individually. The rarity stays the same, and the new card won’t share a family with the other two.
page.p.037: You don’t start as a top-flight regular. Work through the Academy and Reserves, earn your place from the first-team bench, and aim for World Player of the Year, awarded to the world’s best player each season. Your card choices and season records decide how far you go.
page.p.038: Start in the Academy at seventeen. The Youth Start Pack lets you begin at fifteen.
page.p.039: Move up to the Reserves when you approach first-team level or turn nineteen. Promotions are decided at the end of the season.
page.p.040: Debut ages vary by league. Meet the age, ability and season rating requirements to reach the first team. Manager Trust determines your playing time.
page.p.041: Request a transfer or choose an offer, then work with your agent to negotiate wages and clauses such as a Starter's promise or Buy-out clause.
page.p.042: First-team players aged eighteen or older are eligible for a national call-up. The World Tournament and continental championships alternate every two years.
page.p.043: By default, Wingers play until 36 and Goalkeepers until 41. Cards and events can extend your career, and you can also choose to retire earlier.
page.p.044: A season runs for ten months, from August to May, with 38 matches. Appearances, goals, assists, clean sheets, MOM awards and ratings feed into your monthly growth, with every stat change shown in numbers. Advance a month at a time or let the season run automatically.
page.p.046: A strong month can earn Player of the Month, Team of the Month, or Save of the Month for Goalkeepers. Your record decides, with no hidden draw. At season’s end, aim for Top Scorer, Team of the Season, Player of the Year, and even World Player of the Year.
page.p.047: A player career has no squad screen, tactics board or transfer budget. Your manager gives you playing time, and a new manager may want a different kind of player. Running a club happens separately, in the Weekly League.
page.p.048: In situations during the season, each choice shows the odds of three outcomes as bars and percentages before you decide. You can also see how your stats, Manager Trust, Condition and Growth Cards have shifted those odds.
page.p.049: From England, Spain, Germany, Italy and France to Korea, Japan and South America. Debut ages, wages and foreign-player quotas vary by league. All league, club, player and manager names are fictional.
page.p.050: Keep your career totals and a six-axis assessment of Quality, Output, Volume, Awards, Trophies and Stage. See where you rank in the overall distribution of careers. Completed careers enter the season player ranking and the Hall of Fame.
page.p.051: Football Career Sim: Be a Pro is made and run by YT Lab.

page.dd.069: It’s free to download and play all the way to retirement. Growth Cards and their rerolls are free too. Optional purchases include Remove Ads, Position Pack, Youth Start Pack, Supporter Pack, Gold and Reroll Tickets. Starting stat rolls have the same odds whether you use a free roll, an ad or a Reroll Ticket.
page.dd.070: Your career runs and saves on your device, so you can play offline. Rankings, the Weekly League, friend matches, Daily Challenge, purchases, spending Gold and device transfers need an internet connection.
page.dd.071: The full game, through to retirement, is an app for iPhone, iPad and Android. On a PC or phone browser, the web trial lets you play the first five seasons of the same game free, with no install.
page.dd.072: Goalkeeper, Defender, Midfielder, Winger and Striker. Goalkeeper and Striker are free; the Position Pack unlocks the other three. Each position has seven playstyles, for 35 in total, all free.
page.dd.073: Three career slots let you develop three players at once. Your nationality sets your national team, and you choose your starting club from home and overseas offers.
page.dd.074: No. All leagues, clubs, players and managers in the game are fictional.
page.dd.075: Completed careers appear in the rankings, but you can opt out at any time. Custom names are only made public with your consent.

guide.title.102: Football Career Sim Guide: Growth Cards, Transfers, Awards
guide.h1.103: Football Career Sim: Be a Pro guide
guide.h2.104: 1. Getting started: stat rolls and your first league
guide.h2.109: 6. From Player of the Month to World Player of the Year
guide.h3.112: Your nationality decides your first league
guide.h3.120: Six axes and your career percentile
guide.p.122: Growth Cards, first-team promotion, playing time, transfers, contracts, award criteria and retirement assessments. This guide explains the rules the game actually uses.
guide.p.123: Based on app version 2.6, October 25, 2026. Written by YT Lab, the developer of Football Career Sim: Be a Pro.
guide.p.124: By default, a new career starts in the Academy at seventeen. Rolling your starting stats resets your OVR and stat distribution, as well as your hidden potential and growth type. You get 5 free rolls; each ad or Reroll Ticket adds 10 more.
guide.p.125: Free rolls, ads and Reroll Tickets all use the same odds. Spending money gives you more rolls, not a better chance of a high OVR on each roll.
guide.p.126: Your nationality determines your first league and national team. Each league has a different first-team age requirement, so your starting league shapes when you can make your debut.
guide.p.127: Even within a league, club tier changes the debut age and ability requirements. Title contenders debut players one year later and allow a gap of only 8 below first-team level. Lower-ranked clubs debut players two years earlier and accept a gap of up to 13. A smaller club can be a quicker route to first-team football.
guide.p.128: A season runs for ten months, August to May, with 38 matches. You accumulate growth points each month; every time they reach a threshold, a stat rises by 1. Points come from basic training and that month’s performances.
guide.p.129: One MOM award is worth more than three appearances. Even with the same match count, goals, assists and ratings can make a big difference to growth. Academy and Reserves training bonuses keep young players developing even with fewer appearances.
guide.p.130: Every player has a growth type that affects peak age and growth speed.
guide.p.131: Default peak ages are 31 for Goalkeepers, 29 for Defenders, 28 for Midfielders, 27 for Strikers and 26 for Wingers. Physical stats such as Pace peak one year earlier; mental stats such as Reading peak three years later. Young players further from their peak grow more each month: 1.5× when at least 8 years away. Growth drops sharply after the peak.
guide.p.132: Every stat has a hidden ceiling where automatic growth stops. Points blocked by a ceiling move to other stats. Condition is managed automatically: below 50, recovery reduces growth to 0.6×; below 30, rest reduces it to 0.3×.
guide.p.133: Growth Cards appear at the start of your career and every two seasons after that. Pick one of three cards of the same rarity, each from a different family. You can reroll each card once for free. Your first pick is guaranteed Epic; later rounds roll a new rarity each time. Try a pick on the overview page.
guide.p.134: Your share of playing time depends on the gap between your performance and the opposition’s squad level, your fit with the manager, and Manager Trust. That share determines your role.
guide.p.135: Managers change every two years. Each has preferred playstyles, and your fit acts as a multiplier on playing time. Outfield players over 36 and Goalkeepers over 38 receive a smaller share of playing time each year.
guide.p.136: The transfer window opens in summer after the season. Clubs consider your age, reputation, foreign-player quotas and likely role. A club won’t make an offer if it expects you to sit on the bench. Reputation depends on OVR, appearances, the standing of your club and league, age and career rating.
guide.p.137: After at least one season in the same club’s first team, you can request a transfer once per season. The base approval chance is 42%, with large adjustments for your circumstances.
guide.p.138: A rejected request costs 9 Trust, or 12 if you’ve already been refused under the same contract. Even an approved request costs 4.
guide.p.139: Agents have three approaches: Hardball, Pragmatic and Loyal. Higher OVR unlocks more clauses: 1 below 70, 2 in the 70s, and 3 at 80 or above. Negotiations last up to two rounds.
guide.p.140: A new contract isn’t guaranteed. A club may refuse if you’re at least 21 and your OVR is more than 12 below team level, or if it expects you to be on the bench. Playing fewer than 30% of available matches for two consecutive seasons makes you a candidate for release.
guide.p.141: To qualify, you need at least one first-team appearance that month and no more than one missed match. Monthly points are 3 per goal, 2 per assist, 3 per MOM, and 2 per clean sheet for Defenders and Goalkeepers.
guide.p.142: The Player of the Month threshold varies slightly by league level and month. A Goalkeeper earns Save of the Month with a clean sheet, MOM and a rating of at least 7.5 in their best match that month.
guide.p.143: You need at least 22 league appearances. Awards include Top Scorer, Top creator, Golden Glove for Goalkeepers, Team of the Season, Player of the Year, Young Player of the Year for players aged 21 or younger, and Club Player of the Year. Two Player of the Month awards in one season earn Fans’ Player of the Year. Top Scorer compares your record with rivals in the same league each year, so there’s no fixed goal target.
guide.p.144: With at least 22 first-team appearances, your season score earns you a world ranking. Finish first to win. The score includes rating, OVR above 70, position-specific goal contributions or clean sheets, league level, that season’s trophies and awards, and Player of the Month wins. A Champions Cup title gives the largest award bonus at 45, followed by a league title at 30 and Player of the Year at 25. Even if you rank first on points, you finish second unless that season includes a major title (the Champions Cup or a national-team title), a league treble, or a monster season. Goalkeepers must win the Champions Cup, league and national-team titles and the golden glove in the same season. See the award requirements
guide.p.145: To win World Player of the Year, you’ll eventually need a league at level 4 or above. In a level 3 league, even a Champions Cup title only lets you reach fourth.
guide.p.146: First-team players aged eighteen or older can be called up to the senior National Team. The chance uses the lower of two values: one based on reputation and one on ability relative to national team strength. It is capped at 93%. Call-up chances fall at ages 31–33 and fall further from 34. Tournaments take place in even-numbered years: the World Tournament in years divisible by 4, and the continental championships in other even years. A call-up doesn’t guarantee qualification; qualifying exits stay in your record too.
guide.p.147: Events and cards can extend your career by up to 3 years. You can choose to retire in preseason. From age 32, you may be advised to retire if your OVR has fallen at least 9 below your peak and you’ve averaged fewer than 8 appearances over the last two seasons. You can decline and keep playing.
guide.p.148: At retirement, your career score covers six axes: Quality (peak OVR), Output (goal contributions or clean sheets per 100 matches), Volume (total appearances), Awards, Trophies and Stage (leagues and rankings). Awards and Quality carry the most weight. Your percentile compares you with 20,000 careers simulated under the game’s rules.
guide.p.149: Completed careers enter weekly, monthly and all-time rankings. Weekly rankings reset Monday 00:00 UTC. Season rankings compare the combined scores of your best three careers completed that week. The season’s top 30 careers stay in the Hall of Fame.

guide.li.302: Football Career Sim: Be a Pro
guide.li.303: Getting started: stat rolls and your first league
guide.li.308: From Player of the Month to World Player of the Year
guide.li.311: Rerolling won’t upgrade a card’s rarity. It changes the effect within the same rarity.
guide.li.312: Ceiling boosts make the lasting difference. Automatic growth will eventually fill a stat to its ceiling, so a stat-only boost mostly gets you there sooner. Development simulations that ran the same player thousands of times also found that raising ceilings pushed career peaks higher. Cards can raise ceilings to 95.
guide.li.313: Choose conditional cards when you’re getting regular minutes. Ready to Rise (+8 to a core stat after 30 appearances) and Establishing a Place (+3 to a core stat after 15 league appearances) are hard to cash in from the bench.
guide.li.314: Last Flame commits you to retirement. It gives three core stats +6, but you will retire at that season’s end. It only appears with 3 or fewer active years remaining.
guide.li.315: Second Prime is for veterans. It appears after your peak with 1–5 active years remaining. It halves aging for three seasons and extends your career by 2 years.

goalkeeper.title: Goalkeeper Career Game - Football Career Sim: Be a Pro
goalkeeper.desc: Raise a 17-year-old youth goalkeeper through retirement in a free mobile football game. Explore saves, clean sheets, awards and the goalkeeper's special World Player of the Year requirements.
goalkeeper.h1: Goalkeeper Career Game: build a career
goalkeeper.lede: In Football Career Sim: Be a Pro, a goalkeeper has a full career just like a striker. Start in the youth team at 17 and choose your path through your first-team debut, transfers, national team and retirement. Your record tracks saves and clean sheets instead of goals. Goalkeeper and striker are free from the start.
goalkeeper.s1.h2: A later peak and a longer career
goalkeeper.s1.p1: Goalkeepers peak at 31, the latest of the five positions. Strikers peak at 27 and wingers at 26. Outfield players receive less playing time each year after 36; goalkeepers hold on until 38.
goalkeeper.s1.p2: The careers players have completed show the same pattern. The {stat:keeper.n} retired goalkeepers played an average of {stat:keeper.seasons} seasons and retired at {stat:keeper.age}. Strikers averaged {stat:striker.seasons} seasons and retired at {stat:striker.age}. The oldest goalkeeper retired at {stat:keeper.age_max}.
goalkeeper.s2.h2: Saves and clean sheets on the record
goalkeeper.s2.p1: A goalkeeper's season record includes appearances, clean sheets, saves and penalty saves. Clean sheets contribute to monthly growth points and each clean sheet earns two Player of the Month points. Games without conceding help you grow.
goalkeeper.s2.p2: Retired goalkeepers averaged {stat:keeper.cs} clean sheets, with a record of {stat:keeper.cs_max}. They can record assists even without goals: the highest career total by one goalkeeper is {stat:keeper.assists_max}.
goalkeeper.s3.p1: Save of the Month is awarded for regular first-team appearances that month and a clean sheet, MOM and rating of at least 7.5 in your best match of the month.
goalkeeper.s3.p2: Clean Sheet Leader is a goalkeeper award available after at least 22 league appearances in a season. Goalkeepers can also earn Team of the Season and Player of the Year.
goalkeeper.s3.p3: World Player of the Year is the highest hurdle for a goalkeeper. You must win the Champions Cup, league, national-team tournament and Clean Sheet Leader in the same season. Miss one and you finish second even if you top the vote. Goalkeepers rarely win the equivalent award in real football, which is why the rule is strict. See World Player of the Year requirements.
goalkeeper.s4.p1: Choose a play style when you start. Managers prefer different styles, so your choice also affects playing time.
goalkeeper.s4.li1: Sweeper keeper Pushes the line up and clears the space behind it
goalkeeper.s4.li2: Shot stopper Reflexes that stop the big chances
goalkeeper.s4.li3: Commander Moves the back four with his voice
goalkeeper.s4.li4: Aerial keeper Claims everything that comes into the box
goalkeeper.s5.h2: How to start as a goalkeeper
goalkeeper.s5.p1: Install the app and select goalkeeper in a new career. Choose your name and nationality and roll your stats to start in the youth team at 17. No registration or login is needed.
goalkeeper.faq1.q: Can I play as a goalkeeper for free?
goalkeeper.faq1.a: Yes. Goalkeeper and striker are free from the start. Defender, midfielder and winger are unlocked with the position pack.
goalkeeper.faq2.q: Can a goalkeeper win World Player of the Year?
goalkeeper.faq2.a: Yes, but it is hardest for a goalkeeper. Win the Champions Cup, league, national-team tournament and Clean Sheet Leader in the same season.
goalkeeper.faq3.q: How long can a goalkeeper play?
goalkeeper.faq3.a: Age does not reduce playing time until after 38. The average retirement age among completed goalkeeper careers is {stat:keeper.age}.
awards.title: Ballon d'Or game: how to win World Player of the Year - Football Career Sim
awards.desc: The Ballon d'Or equivalent in Football Career Sim is World Player of the Year. Learn the nomination and winning requirements, league-level limits and special goalkeeper rules.
awards.h1: Ballon d'Or game: win World Player of the Year
awards.lede: Like the Ballon d'Or, Football Career Sim has an award for the world's best player each year. In the game it is called World Player of the Year. Season points determine the world ranking, but points alone cannot secure first place: a major achievement that season is also required.
awards.s1.p1: Only seasons with at least 22 first-team appearances qualify. The score considers ratings, attributes, position-specific attacking contributions or clean sheets, league level, trophies, individual awards and Player of the Month awards. The Champions Cup has the largest trophy bonus, followed by the league title and Player of the Year.
awards.s2.p1: Even if you top the vote, you finish second unless you meet one of the following three conditions that season. The app tells you which requirement was missing.
awards.s2.li1: Major title Win the Champions Cup or an international tournament with your national team that year.
awards.s2.li2: League triple crown Win the league, league Player of the Year and the position award: top scorer for strikers, top scorer or assist leader for wingers, assist leader for midfielders, and Defender of the Year for defenders.
awards.s2.li3: Monster season An overwhelming statistical season even without a title.
awards.s2.p2: Goalkeepers are different: all four of the Champions Cup, league title, national-team title and Clean Sheet Leader must be won in the same season. A monster season cannot qualify. Read more in goalkeeper career.
awards.s3.p1: The world watches the biggest leagues. Only a season in a level 4 or higher league can reach first place.
awards.s3.p2: In a level 3 league the best possible rank is 31st without a Champions Cup or national-team title, and fourth with one. In lower leagues you cannot rank without a major title, and the ceiling is 11th even with one.
awards.s4.h2: How to aim for World Player of the Year
awards.s4.li1: Move to a big league. First place is blocked below level 4, however well you play. The transfer market opens in summer after the season.
awards.s4.li2: Join a club in the Champions Cup. Winning it meets the first-place requirement and gives the largest award bonus.
awards.s4.li3: Target a national-team title. International tournaments occur in even years; years divisible by four host the world tournament. A national-team title alone meets the condition that season.
awards.s4.li4: Play consistently each month. Player of the Month awards also count toward your season score.
awards.faq1.q: Is the award called the Ballon d'Or in the game?
awards.faq1.a: No. The game calls it World Player of the Year. It occupies the same place as the Ballon d'Or: an award for one outstanding player each year.
awards.faq2.q: Can I win in a small league?
awards.faq2.a: First place is only possible in a level 4 or higher league. In a level 3 league, fourth is the best even with a major title.
awards.faq3.q: Can I win more than once?
awards.faq3.a: Yes. You can win in every qualifying season, and the number of awards contributes to your retirement career evaluation.
positions.title: Best position in a football career game - Football Career Sim
positions.desc: Compare peak ages, records, awards and player career averages for all five positions.
positions.h1: Best position in a football career game
positions.lede: Your position changes your peak age, recorded statistics and available awards. Striker and goalkeeper are free from the start; defender, midfielder and winger are unlocked with the position pack.
positions.s1.p1: Averages use {stat:all.n} careers completed through retirement. Of those, {stat:striker.share}% were strikers and {stat:keeper.share}% were goalkeepers.
positions.s2.p1: Strikers are judged on goals. Their season award is top scorer, and their Player of the Month threshold of around 18 points is the highest of the five positions. Retired strikers averaged {stat:striker.goals} goals; the record is {stat:striker.goals_max}.
positions.s3.p1: Wingers peak earliest at 26 and also retire earliest (average {stat:winger.age}). They alone can complete the league triple crown with either top scorer or assist leader. Retired wingers averaged {stat:winger.goals} goals and {stat:winger.assists} assists.
positions.s4.p1: Reading the game and passing are central. The individual award is assist leader, and the Player of the Month threshold is around 11 points. Retired midfielders averaged {stat:midfielder.assists} assists; the record is {stat:midfielder.assists_max}.
positions.s5.p1: A peak at 29 helps defenders maintain their ability longer. Clean sheets are recorded for defenders, who can win Defender of the Year. The Player of the Month threshold is around 10 points. Retired defenders averaged {stat:defender.cs} clean sheets; the record is {stat:defender.cs_max}.
positions.s6.p1: Goalkeepers peak latest at 31 and play longest, averaging {stat:keeper.seasons} seasons. Their World Player of the Year requirements are the strictest. See goalkeeper career.
positions.s7.p1: The younger and further from the peak, the greater the monthly growth; it declines rapidly after the peak. Late-peaking goalkeepers and defenders grow longer, while wingers bloom early. Physical attributes such as pace peak one year earlier, and mental attributes such as reading the game three years later.
positions.faq1.a: Striker and goalkeeper. Defender, midfielder and winger are unlocked with the position pack.
positions.faq2.q: Which position is best for a beginner?
positions.faq2.a: A striker's visible goals and assists make records easiest to read. If you want to develop one player for longer, choose a goalkeeper, who peaks latest.
offline.title: Offline football career game - Football Career Sim: Be a Pro
offline.desc: Football Career Sim calculates careers on your phone. See what works without internet, what needs a connection and how completed offline careers reach the rankings.
offline.lede: Careers in Football Career Sim are calculated on your phone, not a server. You can advance seasons, choose growth cards, transfer and retire without a connection, including on the subway or a plane. Registration and login are unnecessary.

offline.s2.li1: Refresh rankings and Hall of Fame
offline.s2.li3: Start a career using start cards
offline.s2.li5: Store purchases, ad rewards, notices and inbox
offline.s3.h2: Offline careers can reach the rankings
offline.s3.p1: If you participate in rankings, a career retired offline is stored on the device and submitted when you reopen the app with a connection. Careers with no completed season are not submitted.
offline.s3.p2: The weekly ranking restarts Monday 00:00 UTC. Players have submitted {stat:all.n} careers to the rankings so far.
offline.faq1.q: Do I need to log in?
offline.faq1.a: No. Start immediately without registration or Apple or Google login.
offline.faq2.q: Do offline careers appear in the rankings?
offline.faq2.a: Yes. If you participate in rankings and have completed at least one season, the career is submitted the next time you open the app online.
page.webplay: Want to try it before installing? Start playing in your browser
web.title: Football Career Simulator Online - Play in Your Browser - Football Career Sim
web.desc: Try Football Career Sim in your browser before installing the app. Play the first five seasons of the same game for free, without signing up.
web.h1: Play Football Career Sim in your browser
web.lede: Try it in your browser now, without installing anything. The web demo is the same game as the mobile app: create a 17-year-old youth player and play through the first five seasons. No registration or login is required.
web.play.note: Works in both desktop and mobile browsers. The game files may take a few seconds to download the first time.
web.s1.h2: What you can do in the web demo
web.s1.li1: Create a player by choosing a name, nationality and position (striker or goalkeeper), then rolling the stat dice
web.s1.li2: Play five seasons, following monthly match results and growth
web.s1.li3: Choose one of three growth cards at the start and every two seasons
web.s1.li4: Make your first-team debut, earn playing time and enter the summer transfer market
web.s1.p1: Return in the same browser to continue your player’s career.
web.s2.li1: The full career from season six through retirement, including your retirement evaluation
web.s2.li2: Rankings, Hall of Fame, Today's League and Daily Challenge
web.s2.li3: Defender, midfielder and winger positions, plus the store
web.s2.p1: Progress in the web demo does not transfer to the app. You start over with a new player in the app.
web.s3.h2: The demo is the same game
web.s3.p1: The web demo runs on the same code as the mobile app, not a separate mini-game. Growth rules, growth cards, playing time and transfer criteria are all the same, so what you learn in the demo also applies in the app.
web.faq1.a: Yes. Both the web demo and the app are free. The app offers optional purchases.
web.faq2.q: Can I transfer my player from the demo to the app?
web.faq2.a: No. Players created on the web cannot be transferred to the app. You start with a new player in the app.
web.faq3.q: What devices can I play on?
web.faq3.a: You can play on a computer or phone with a modern browser. On a phone, the app is faster and lets you continue all the way to retirement.
page.club.p: Keep a retired player in your archive and they join your club’s squad in the Weekly League. Set the formation and tactics with the players you raised and take on other clubs every week. No retired players yet? You can enter with default players.
page.club.pa: Prepare your squad on Monday and play the league Tuesday to Friday. Saturday is the cup group stage and Sunday the knockouts.
page.club.pb: Each week’s results decide promotion and relegation. Start in the lower divisions and climb to World Class.
page.club.pc: Add friends by code, pick a formation and tactics, and play friendlies. Lost? Get it back with a revenge match.
page.club.pd: Everyone gets the same player, develops them for eight seasons and competes for the top score before the board closes.
